reuse.why: All affected consumers reuse applyWeekendRule, which delegates movement to the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend helper.

duplication.why: Weekend, holiday and daily-skip decisions are shared rather than copied into individual consumers.

placement.why: Calendar policy remains in shared/schedules.ts, configuration belongs in the model, and handler registration stays in the server schedules module.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested scheduling rules, range handler and supporting tests.

maintainability.why: The shared policy is clear, but consumer-owned search assumptions such as WEEKEND_SHIFT_DAYS and RECUR_LOOKAHEAD_OCCURRENCES couple enumeration to details of the evolving calendar rule.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The modified consumers and new range handler all route occurrence adjustment through applyWeekendRule.

disguised_duplication.where: The change centralizes policy rather than reshaping copies of it.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains the requested holidays parameter, and applyWeekendRule explicitly names the daily-skip variation without consumer-specific exceptions.
